text: Employees receive 24 days of paid leave per year.
Employees can carry forward up to 10 unused paid leave days to the next year.
Employees must submit leave requests at least 3 working days before the planned leave.
Sick leave is available to employees when they are unable to work due to illness.
Employees may be required to provide a medical certificate for sick leave longer than 3 consecutive working days.
Employees receive 12 public holidays during the calendar year.
The standard working hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM from Monday to Friday.
Employees receive a one-hour lunch break during the standard working day.
Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval.
Remote employees must remain available during core working hours from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
Employees must use company-approved devices and secure networks when working remotely.
Employees receive their monthly salary on the last working day of each month.
Salary payments are deposited directly into the employee's registered bank account.
Employees are eligible for an annual performance review after completing 12 months of employment.
Performance reviews consider job responsibilities, individual goals, teamwork, and overall performance.
Employees must complete mandatory security and compliance training during their first 30 days.
Employees may access optional professional development courses with manager approval.
Employees must keep their company passwords confidential and must not share them with other people.
Employees must report suspected security incidents to the IT security team immediately.
Company laptops must use approved security software and must not be modified without IT approval.
Employees must not share confidential company information with unauthorized individuals.
Confidential company documents must be stored only in approved company storage systems.
Employees must return company equipment when their employment ends.
Employees are responsible for taking reasonable care of company-issued laptops, phones, and other equipment.
Employees should report damaged or lost company equipment to their manager and IT department.
Employees must maintain a professional and respectful workplace environment.
Harassment, discrimination, bullying, and threatening behavior are prohibited in the workplace.
Employees should report workplace conduct concerns to their manager or Human Resources department.
Employees may claim reimbursement for approved business travel expenses.
Business travel expenses must be supported by valid receipts when required by the company.
Employees should submit business expense claims within 30 days of the expense date.
Employees can request a promotion when they meet the requirements of an available role and have demonstrated sustained performance.
Promotion decisions may consider performance, skills, experience, responsibilities, and business requirements.
New employees are required to complete an initial probation period of 6 months.
During probation, employees receive regular feedback from their manager.
Employees who leave the company must complete the required notice period stated in their employment agreement.
The standard notice period for eligible employees is 30 days unless the employment agreement specifies otherwise.
Employees must complete an exit process and return company property before their final working day.
Employees may be eligible for health insurance benefits according to the company's benefits plan.
Health insurance enrollment must be completed within the eligibility period specified by the benefits team.
Employees should contact Human Resources for questions about benefits, leave, payroll, or workplace policies.
